_readme: Copy this to ads/listings.json and fill it in. listings.json is gitignored
because it holds property names and street addresses, which are internal
reference only and never appear in a public ad.
Every field below is required unless marked optional. A field that is absent
means 'not confirmed', and the generator will refuse to write that ad rather
than invent a number. Use null only where noted.
id                 short slug used for the draft filename
internal           property_name, address, optional also_never_print list.
Used only to search, disambiguate, and run the leak check.
management         'greystar' triggers the mandatory TMLP pricing block
zip, area          the approved level of specificity for a public ad
slogan             first line, no emoji, must be unique across the batch
standout           the one real feature the ad is built around
header_callout     optional, defaults to standout
insider            optional. Omit it rather than pad it with something generic
unit_sentence      optional override for the bed/bath sentence
special            null if there is genuinely no special. Never a guess.
tmlp               required when management is greystar
amenities          kind drives priority order: pool, gym, dog park, garage,
ev charging, rooftop, coworking. Capped at 3 bullets total,
including the pet line.
pet_policy         optional. This line owns the paw emoji.
divider            one of  ★ ✦ ✧ ✩ ✪ ❖ ◆  and varied across the batch

listings.slogan: South Austin skyline views, without the downtown price tag.
listings.insider: Locals know this stretch of South Austin gets you five minutes from the greenbelt without the I-35 traffic.
listings.unit_sentence: Rooftop pool with skyline views right outside your door. Spacious 2 bed, 2 bath layout with room to spread out.
listings.special: one month free on a 13-month lease

listings.slogan: A fenced yard in Austin, which is rarer than a free parking spot.
listings.header_callout: private fenced yard on a quiet interior street
listings.insider: The trailhead at the end of the street connects straight through to the greenbelt, so you skip the parking lot entirely.
